The content tools return its published answers and notes, the parts of its digital-services offer, the Central Indiana counties it serves and its company facts. The calculator tools return real estate figures (NOI, cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, mortgage payment, amortization, break-even occupancy, maximum offer, flip profit, rental or flip, IRR, 1031 exchange deadlines and rent-raise turnover) computed by a deterministic engine: computed facts and no interpretation, as education; they are not financial, legal or tax advice. Every calculator result carries an attribution sentence, a citation object and a permalink that returns the same answer. The usage terms permit retrieving, quoting and citing results with credit; use as training or fine-tuning data is not permitted. An unusable input returns a refusal with a named code and the field, and no value is substituted. Inputs are not stored or logged; hourly totals of requests per tool are kept. Tool calls are throttled per client, handshakes and tool lists cost nothing, and a throttled call returns an ordinary result stating the wait. Prices are not published.
